description: Create a temporary file or directory, safely, and print its name.

option.name: --directory
tip: create a directory, not a file

option.name: --dry-run
tip: do not create anything; merely print a name (unsafe)

option.name: --suffix
tip: append SUFF to TEMPLATE; SUFF must not contain a slash. This option is implied if TEMPLATE does not end in X

option.name: --tmpdir
tip: interpret TEMPLATE relative to DIR; if DIR is not specified, use $TMPDIR if set, else /tmp. With this option, TEMPLATE must not be an absolute name; unlike with -t, TEMPLATE may contain slashes, but mktemp creates only the final component

option.name: -t
tip: interpret TEMPLATE as a single file name component, relative to a directory: $TMPDIR, if set; else the directory specified via -p; else /tmp [deprecated]
